term.title: relative atomic mass
term.longtitle: IUPAC Gold Book - relative atomic mass

definitions.text: The ratio of the average mass of the atom to the unified atomic mass unit.
sources: PAC, 1996, 68, 957. 'Glossary of terms in quantities and units in Clinical Chemistry (IUPAC-IFCC Recommendations 1996)' on page 990 (https://doi.org/10.1351/pac199668040957)
